description: Defines the GlobalDefaults class for managing global default settings in an ERP system, including methods for updating defaults, toggling display options, and interacting with the database.

classes.name: GlobalDefaults
classes.description: A Document subclass managing global default settings, including update routines and UI toggles.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Updates default settings in the database based on current object properties, adjusts fiscal year dates, enables currency, and clears cache.

methods.name: toggle_rounded_total
methods.description: Hides or shows rounded total fields in various doctypes based on the disable_rounded_total flag.

methods.name: toggle_in_words
methods.description: Hides or shows 'in words' fields in various doctypes based on the disable_in_words flag.
